name: Home Help
description: Home Help is an assistance product that provides domestic support to eligible clients through multiple support categories with financial assessment and review processes.

attributes.summary: Home Help provides domestic support assistance to eligible clients, covering qualifications, support categories (Domestic Support, Domestic Emergency, Home Support), financial assessment, payment, and review processes.
attributes.eligibility: Ordinarily resident, Permanent residence, Proof of residence, Immigration status and supporting documents, Current Community Services Card, Cash asset test
attributes.payment_details: Paying accounts, Travel costs, Commencement date
